text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating!
I couldn't... I couldn't return everyone's love...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even though everyone cheered for me so hard...
I really, truly wanted to win...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't stay like this...
I have to work much harder!
choice_data_list: As long as you feel that way, you'll be just fine!
Let's fire ourselves up even more than before!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even in defeat, these feelings haven't changed...
If anything, they've grown even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"To answer everyone's love...
To give that love right back...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright! I'll train hard for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please don't hold anything back!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about doing
a livestream of your training session?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "I'll make good use of stream time for training too, and next time, I'll definitely deliver love to everyone!"
